channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: WTI Oil drops below $80 amid hopes of Hormuz reopening, US-Iran de-escalation
item.description: Crude prices extend their reversal on Wednesday, with the US benchmark West Texas Intermediate (WTI) trading at the $79.50 area as of writing, highlighting a 9% decline from last week’s highs above $87.00.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Watching 0.7200 resistance against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note AUD/USD extended its consolidation slightly higher, closing at 0.7165 as short-term momentum improves.

item.title: Hungarian Forint: Recovery tied to euro entry story – ING
item.description: ING’s Chris Turner reports that the National Bank of Hungary cut its policy rate by 25bp to 5.50%, with Chief Economist Peter Virovacz seeing a 4.75% terminal rate.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) fell on Wednesday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $68.54 per troy ounce, down 0.16% from the $68.65 it cost on Tuesday.

item.title: US Dollar Index: Range trade persists as data soft – DBS
item.description: DBS Group Research economist Philip Wee notes that the DXY Index’s recent recovery stalled slightly above 99 and has reverted to a 98.5–99.0 range after last week’s sell-off linked to higher US long bond yields.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Tests nine-day EMA confluence support near 185.00
item.description: EUR/JPY depreciates after registering modest gains, trading around 185.60 during the European hours on Wednesday. The technical analysis of a daily chart indicates that the currency cross is remaining within the ascending channel pattern, signaling an ongoing bullish bias.

item.title: Brent: Diplomatic progress weighs on prices – OCBC
item.description: OCBC Bank strategists Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong note that improved prospects for shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and diplomatic developments involving Iran and Oman have eased supply concerns, pushing Brent crude below USD90/bbl.

item.title: US Dollar: Shaky basis trade risks weigh – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur explains how the US Treasury Secretary’s vague secondary sanctions comments and falling US yields have left the Dollar stabilizing but vulnerable.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD bulls await break above $70.00 amid mixed setup
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) continues its struggle to make it through the $70.00 psychological mark and extends its two-way price moves through the first half of the European session on Wednesday.

item.title: Swiss Franc ticks up against US Dollar despite bright Swiss ZEW economic expectations
item.description: The Swiss Franc (CHF) is trading lower against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday, but it has managed to trim some losses after the release of an upbeat Swiss ZEW Economic Expectations Index.

item.title: Australian Dollar remains stronger as CPI YoY climbs in July
item.description: AUD/USD extends its gains for the second consecutive day, trading around 0.7180 during the European hours on Wednesday.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Rally extends further to near 114.30 as hawkish RBA bets accelerate
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) trades 0.13% higher at around 114.30 against the Japanese Yen (JPY) during the European trading session on Wednesday.

item.title: Australian Dollar: RBA risks seen underpriced – MUFG
item.description: Derek Halpenny at MUFG says the August RBA minutes and stronger-than-expected monthly CPI reinforce the risk of an earlier rate hike than markets currently price.

item.title: Euro advances against Canadian Dollar amid falling oil prices
item.description: EUR/CAD extends its gains for the third successive day, trading around 1.6180 during the European hours on Wednesday. The currency cross gains ground as the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) faces headwinds due to falling crude oil prices.

item.title: Forex Today: US Dollar extends consolidation ahead of key inflation data, Nvidia earnings
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Wednesday, August 26:

item.title: Euro: Schnabel’s upbeat tone supports against US Dollar – ING
item.description: Chris Turner at ING highlights that Eurozone data continue to surprise positively and ECB’s Isabel Schnabel now sees growth risks possibly to the upside.

item.title: Gold refreshes daily low, around $4,625 as USD sticks to modest gains ahead of US PCE
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) touches a fresh daily low, around the $4,630-$4,625 region, during the first half of the European session on Wednesday, though the downside seems limited.

item.title: Dow Jones futures hold flat as traders await US PCE inflation data, Nvidia earnings
item.description: Dow Jones futures gain steadies around 53,650 during European hours on Wednesday. Meanwhile, S&P 500 futures decline by 0.11%, to trade near 7,680, and Nasdaq 100 futures fall by 0.23% to trade around 29,210.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Range-bound trading outlook against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank (UOB) analysts Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann describe USD/JPY as remaining in a range-trading phase. For the 24-hour view they see the Dollar fluctuating between 158.95 and 159.50 after recent narrow ranges and little-changed closes.

item.title: US core PCE inflation set to keep pressure on the Federal Reserve to hike interest rates
item.description: The United States (US) Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) is expected to publish the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) Price Index data for July on Wednesday, at 12:30 GMT.

item.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Bears prevail with the 200-day SMA capping rallies
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) nurses marginal gains on Wednesday and holds a mild recovery attempt from the three-month highs hit last week, but seems unable to extend gains past the 200-day Simple Moving Average (SMA), just above 99.00, which keeps the broader bearish structure intact.

item.title: Euro holds above mid-1.1600s vs USD; looks to US PCE data for fresh impetus
item.description: The EUR/USD pair struggles to capitalize on the previous day's modest bounce from the weekly low, and trades with a negative bias through the early European session on Wednesday.

item.title: British Pound weakens against Japanese Yen amid hawkish BoJ prospects
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) is under pressure against the Japanese Yen (JPY) on Wednesday, trading 0.22% lower at around 216.85 during the European trading session.

item.title: Brent: Prices extend sharp decline – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank’s Early Morning Reid team, including Peter Sidorov and Jim Reid, note that Brent Oil has reversed more than half of its recent 13% rally as Middle East de-escalation headlines weigh on energy markets.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD rises to near $69.00 ahead of US PCE inflation data
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) extends its gains for the second successive day, trading around $68.80 per troy ounce during the European hours on Wednesday.

item.title: US Dollar: Buyback impact stays marginal – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Geoff Yu notes that U.S. cross‑border exposures have stabilized, with Dollar FX hedges broadly unchanged and U.S. equity holdings recovering as risk sentiment improves.

item.title: Euro wavers within range against British Pound with markets calm and little data
item.description: The Euro (EUR) edges up for the second consecutive day against the British Pound (GBP) on Wednesday, trading halfway within the monthly range.

item.title: Hungarian Forint: MNB caution offers modest HUF support - Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Tatha Ghose reports that Hungary’s central bank, Magyar Nemzeti Bank (MNB), cut its base rate to 5.50% but avoided pre-committing to further easing, stressing that September’s Inflation Report will guide policy. The bank will monitor global rate hikes, could limit the scope.

item.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Dips below 0.5950, fresh weekly low as USD firms ahead of US PCE
item.description: The NZD/USD pair comes under some renewed selling pressure on Wednesday and drops to a fresh weekly low, around the 0.5945 region during the early European session.

item.title: Euro: Holds near 1.1670 against US Dollar as rate moves offset - Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Research Team reports that EUR/USD remained little changed around 1.1670, with the chart showing only a modest pullback from overnight highs before a partial recovery.
